name: Quant Lite
description: Deliberately stripped-down sibling of quant-v0: reuses the same real, point-in-time-safe fair-value model (@quant-fusion/quant-sdk-js's computeSecurityAlpha, same 11 real-price-anchored securities) but replaces its 5-signal ensemble/correlation/portfolio-construction pipeline with a single valuation-gap ranking, a small top-K equal-weight book, and a wide rebalance deadband — targeting quant-v0's own measured weaknesses (near-zero contribution from 4 of its 5 signals, ~3.5-3.7% cost drag from frequent rebalancing) rather than a new, unproven signal.
